title: Certify v0.19.0: Part O, an explicit oriented graph gives k(3,6) >= 73 (Erdős Problem #112)
description:
Part O of Certify. An explicit Cayley digraph on Z_24 x Z_3 with 25 generators has no three pairwise non-adjacent vertices and no transitive tournament on six vertices, so k(3,6) = r(I_3, L_6) >= 73 (Erdős Problem #112). The largest published lower bound found is 71 (T. S. Orden, Zenodo, 2026-11-20, doi:10.5281/zenodo.24390891). The first property has a short proof by hand; the second is checked on the whole graph by two independently written standard-library programs, and by vertex-transitivity it is a check of a 25-vertex subdigraph. Every check ran on one machine.

The release also records two graphs for k(7,3) >= 39 and k(8,3) >= 47. Those bounds are Orden's, published first; the two graphs are his up to explicit relabellings, which a shipped script checks.

Files: k36/note.pdf (paper), k36/note.md and k36/note.tex, k36/certificates/ (three JSON arc lists), k36/scripts/ (four standard-library scripts). This version also adds the DOI of v0.18.0 to the README and CITATION.cff.
